SELECT q.no,q.title,q.answer,q.score,q.description,q.theme, q.type,q.difficulty, o.option1,o.option2,o.option3,o.option4 FROM exam_question q LEFT JOIN exam_option o ON q.no=o.question_no ORDER BY q.no ASC OFFSET 600 ROWS FETCH NEXT 800 ROWS ONLY
